crop.notes: A 'Pugilistic Pickings' roundup column; Allen is in the first and third items and named in the Bill Davis item. Last letters of a few lines at the right edge are clipped

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat reported that $500 a side was put up the night before at Allen's saloon in the McCoole-Allen match, and that Allen and Coyne's exhibitions in the Eastern cities drew large crowds.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads Daily Democrat, Sunday Morning, October 10, 1869

facts.fact: $500 a side was put up at Allen's saloon in the match between Mike McCoole and Tom Allen
Allen and Jim Coyne gave successful exhibitions in the Eastern cities, drawing large crowds

notes: The Bill Davis testimonial mentions Davis had fought Allen; no new Allen fact there
